jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite animation atlas for original adult male hero VOLT. Reference image is identity only. Preserve exact tall swept black crest with white/silver sharp fins, narrow blue V visor, black fitted armour, white shoulder collar, white forearm/shin guards, blue zigzag seams, athletic adult male body. EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, FOUR equal SQUARE cells. Full body isolated in each cell, same body size and torso centre, same ground baseline. Each figure fits within middle 65 percent of its cell, generous fully transparent margins of at least 15 percent above head and below feet and either side. No cropping, stray fragments, no extra characters, background, labels, shadows, effects or motion streaks. Genuine alpha. Crisp detailed western comic-book ink/cel shading, not pixel art. This is a four-phase in-place run loop; every cell MUST have a different phase and arms counter-swing opposite the forward leg. Do NOT repeat same leading leg. Modest relaxed run, no punching or hopping. ALL FOUR sprites face RIGHT in exact same steep three-quarter TOP-DOWN side profile. Near limbs lit clearly, far limbs slightly darker so their identities remain readable. TOP LEFT/contact A: NEAR LEG reaches FORWARD RIGHT, near boot clearly in front of hips, FAR LEG extends BACK LEFT. NEAR ARM swings BACK LEFT, FAR ARM swings FORWARD RIGHT. TOP RIGHT/passing A: near foot supports under hips, far knee passes forward under body, both elbows passing torso. BOTTOM LEFT/contact B MUST BE OPPOSITE of top left: NEAR LEG extends BACK LEFT with near boot BEHIND hips; FAR LEG reaches FORWARD RIGHT. NEAR ARM swings FORWARD RIGHT, FAR ARM BACK LEFT. Near forearm must visibly change from behind torso in cell1 to in front of torso in cell3. BOTTOM RIGHT/passing B: far foot supports under hips, near knee passes forward under body, elbows passing torso. This alternation is the primary requirement. Do not draw all four poses with same front boot or same arm in front. Anatomically coherent short stride, knees below waist.

north-cleanup-prompt.prompt: Edit this four-cell back-view Volt running atlas. Keep exactly the FOUR existing characters, their different leg and opposing arm phases, black-and-silver crested helmets, costumes, proportions and positions. REMOVE EVERY white divider/grid line, white splatter, border, blue glow cloud and detached fragment outside the actual character silhouettes. Replace those areas with genuine fully transparent alpha. The ONLY nontransparent pixels should be the four complete characters. Add generous transparent padding around each full-body figure within its own quadrant; slightly reduce all four uniformly if needed so heads/boots never touch quadrant boundaries. Exact 2 columns by2 rows equal cells, consistent scale. No text, checkerboard, shadows, new effects, or duplicated limbs. Preserve existing character poses; this is background cleanup and safe sprite isolation.
